rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for the sweet cherries commonly sold in Hong Kong.

example.english: I bought a box of cherry fruit to take home.
example.traditional: 我買咗盒車厘子返屋企。
example.jyutping: ngo5 maai5 zo2 hap6 ce1 lei4 zi2 faan1 uk1 kei2

rows.note: Use this for cherries in general, especially when the variety or a written-style context matters.

example.jyutping: jing1 tou4 tung1 soeng4 hai6 hung4 sik1 ge3

rows.note: Use this specifically for the tree or shrub that bears cherries.

example.english: The farm planted several cherry trees.
example.traditional: 農場入面種咗幾棵櫻桃樹。
example.jyutping: nung4 coeng4 jap6 min6 zung3 zo2 gei2 fo2 jing1 tou4 syu6
